title: thebasics:thebasics-handbook-title-teleportation
text: Teleportation collects The BASICs' non-request teleport tools. All five command families are opt-in by default. Enable the desired Teleportation.Register... settings, then restart the server so The BASICs can register those commands. Server config also controls privileges, warmups, cooldowns, temporal gear costs, and safety gates. Staff can inspect and adjust live settings with /thebasics config; most non-registration teleport settings are live reloadable. v5.8.1 upgrade safety The first v5.8.1 load sets all five command-registration settings off and records a one-time migration marker. This also resets servers that briefly enabled a command under v5.8.0 because v5.8.0 did not record whether a true value was intentional or merely its default. After upgrading, re-enable only the command families you want and restart. Later explicit choices are preserved. Homes - /sethome: save your default home. - /sethome <name>: save a named home. - /home: return to your default home. - /home <name>: return to a named home. - /homes: list saved homes. - /delhome <name>: delete a saved home. Use /delhome default for your default home. Spawn - /spawn: teleport to The BASICs spawn, or to the world's default spawn if staff have not set one. - /setspawn: staff command that sets The BASICs spawn destination without changing vanilla respawn behavior. Back - /back: return to the spot recorded before your last server-side teleport. It stores one previous location and expires after the configured window. A successful /back records the place you left, so repeated /back uses can move between the two latest teleport locations after any configured cooldown. This first pass only supports same-dimension return locations. The global recorder runs only when Teleportation.RegisterBackCommand is enabled, and catches The BASICs teleports, accepted TPA teleports, and vanilla teleports that go through the normal player teleport path. Top and stuck - /top: teleport to a safe surface above your current vertical column, checking adjacent columns if needed. - /stuck: slow emergency teleport to spawn. It can remind the waiting player, notify staff, and optionally refuse to run while another online player has the configured help/admin privilege. Set that block privilege empty to always allow /stuck. Warmups and cancellation When warmups are enabled, stand still until the teleport completes. Moving, taking damage, or interacting can cancel the warmup depending on config. Cooldowns start after a successful teleport. Temporal gear requirements are checked before warmup and consumed only when the teleport completes. Enabling commands Enable only the desired Teleportation.RegisterHomeCommands, RegisterSpawnCommands, RegisterStuckCommand, RegisterTopCommand, and RegisterBackCommand settings, then restart. Player-facing command privileges remain configurable and default to chat after opt-in; /setspawn remains restricted to commandplayer by default.
